text: Route loop-worker graph reads and writes through the backend instead of raw .bowman file access
description: agent-tools/idea-file-tools.ts is a second, file-based implementation of the agent graph API used only by the loop-worker (prioritize, idea context, hygiene, create/update/commit idea). The backend always runs when a worker runs (it spawns it), yet worker writes bypass it: no per-file locks (races with backend writes to the same idea), no change events (UI does not update, no undo history), no search/embedding index update, no parent-color inheritance, and a much simpler graph hygiene. Selection, ranking and mission paths are already shared (96f73a7, 6b26d9c); the write path and hygiene are not. Proposal: the backend passes its WS port to the spawned worker, and the worker calls the backend tRPC procedures (same client as MCP) instead of writing files; then delete the duplicated file tools. Risk: the worker then needs a reachable backend; today it can run against a project with no backend.
reflection: Implemented in 8724d0b (preceded by the shared selection/paths/schema work in 96f73a7, 6b26d9c, ece2416). agent-tools/idea-file-tools.ts (230 lines) deleted; connectGraph(projectPath) in agent-tools/graph-tools.ts is a tRPC client to the backend (PORT_BACKEND_WS, inherited from the spawning backend's env; Node 22 global WebSocket, so no ws dependency). Worker search is now real semantic search (idea.searchSemantic) instead of keyword matching; hygiene is the backend's full graphHygiene. Stop policy uses shared isOngoingState (the old list missed 'review'). Verified: agent-tools, loop-worker and shared typechecks and tests; pnpm check 25/25; loop-worker tsdown bundle contains no runtime backend import; integration script against the running backend: real-graph listIdeas (777), getPrioritizedIdeas, getIdeaContext (2 paths), semantic search hits, hygiene; scratch project create → child linked to parent, status update, branch color inherited; process exits cleanly after close(). Not verified: a full live loop cycle (needs a provider API key and incurs model cost). Known limitation: the worker now needs a reachable backend; it is always spawned by one.

reflections.context: The earlier verification left out a full live loop cycle, attributed to needing a paid API key. Closed that gap with a local fake OpenAI-compatible streaming server instead (2026-10-15).
reflections.outcome: Real loop-worker process (from source) against a scratch project created through the running backend: phase + committed idea, loop definition with provider openai-compatible pointing at the fake server, stopPolicy phase_done. The worker oriented through the backend (offered get_prioritized_ideas, get_idea_context, search_ideas_semantic, graph_hygiene, create_idea, update_idea, commit_idea_to_phase), made 2 model requests, executed the model's update_idea call through the backend (idea status implemented, comment preserved), then the stop policy read the phase through the backend and ended the instance as done ('Target phase done: Now'). Exit code 0 after 3 s, empty stderr.
reflections.effectiveness: Verifies the whole changed path (orientation, tool execution, write through backend, stop policy, clean socket close), which unit tests and the read/write script did not cover. Costs nothing and touches no real graph.
reflections.lesson: 'Needs a paid key' is usually a test-design blocker, not a real one: a 40-line fake provider makes the autonomous loop testable end to end. Worth turning into a repeatable smoke check if loop work continues.

status.comment: Implemented (8724d0b) and verified end to end, including a full worker cycle against a fake model through the running backend. Awaiting Felix's acceptance.
